english.codeFreq.howIntro: Each cell shows the proportion of one source covered by one code, expressed as a percentage. The denominator depends on the source kind:
english.codeFreq.howText: Text / Markdown: % of characters covered (overlapping codings counted once).
english.codeFreq.howMedia: Audio / Video: % of duration covered by the union of time-range codings.
english.codeFreq.howPdfRegion: PDF (region codings): % of region selections coded with this code.
english.codeFreq.howPdfMixed: PDF (mixed): weighted average of the two above, by the count of each kind of selection in the source.
english.codeFreq.howImage: Image: % of region selections coded with this code.
english.codeOrders.dragCodes: Drag codes from the Code Browser to build the visualisation
english.codeOrders.selectDocuments: Select documents using the Document Selector above
english.combos.nodeTimes_one: “{{word}}”: in phrases {{count}} time. Click to see it in the Word Tree
english.combos.nodeTimes_other: “{{word}}”: in phrases {{count}} times. Click to see it in the Word Tree
english.combos.dragCodes: Drag codes into Coded with to look at the words in their passages
english.combos.dragQueries: Drag saved queries into the From these queries box to look at the words in their results
english.combos.noRepeats: No phrases repeat often enough. Try a lower number in Appears at least.
english.combos.codedTitle: Look only at the passages coded with the chosen codes.
english.combos.queryTitle: Look only at the results of the chosen saved queries. Each query searches the documents chosen in it.
english.combos.onlyHint: Leave empty to include all words. Otherwise, phrases must contain, and associations must be, one of these words
english.combos.leaveOutHint: Phrases can't start or end with these words, and they aren't shown as associations. Common words (stop words) are left out by default
english.combos.viewPhrasesTitle: Show sequences of words that repeat.
english.combos.viewAssociationsTitle: Show the words that appear in the same sentences as a chosen word.
english.combos.viewTreeTitle: Show the words that come before and after a chosen word.
english.combos.listTitle: Show the phrases as a list, commonest first.
english.combos.networkTitle: Show the words that follow each other in the phrases, joined by lines.
english.combos.appearsAtLeastTitle: Show only the phrases that appear at least this many times.
english.combos.minTogetherTitle: How many sentences a word must share with the chosen word to be shown.
english.combos.g2Note: G² above {{g2}} means the words share sentences more often than chance at p < {{p}}; above {{g2Strict}}, at p < {{pStrict}}. Greyed values are below {{g2}}.
english.combos.allLeftOut: Every phrase is made of left-out words, so there is nothing to join.
english.combos.noShared: No word shares enough sentences with “{{word}}”. Try a lower minimum.
english.combos.togetherTitle: Sentences containing both this word and “{{word}}”
english.combos.pctOfSentencesTitle: Share of the sentences with “{{word}}” that also contain this word
english.combos.g2Title: Log-likelihood: how unlikely it is that the words share this many sentences by chance
